affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 15% Chance to Restore +22.0% Primary Resource
{c_mythic}Gain a random Shrine effect for {c_number}20{/c} seconds after killing an Elite enemy. Can only occur once every {c_number}30{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The angel Lycander left us a portion of her power in this spear. It is all the proof I need that she watches over us still."
- Oracle Argoysni
raw_en.name: Ahavarion, Spear of Lycander

affixesDesc: 幸运一击: 最多有 15% 几率恢复 +22.0% 主要资源
{c_mythic}消灭精英敌人后，获得一种随机圣坛效果，持续 {c_number}20{/c} 秒。每 {c_number}30{/c} 秒只能触发一次。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor:
“天使莱姗德在这把长矛中为我们留下了她的一部分力量。这足以证明她仍在守护着我们。”
——神谕者阿尔戈斯尼
raw_zh.name: 阿瓦里昂，莱姗德之矛

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Claw{/c} gains all Variants for free and deals {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "She has existed in Scosglen since before Fiacla-Géar walked the land. Her purpose is a mystery to us all. However, approach her with deference; she may grant you her counsel."-Airidah, to Donan
raw_en.name: Greatstaff of the Crone

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}爪击{/c}免费获得所有变体，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 150]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “在菲亚克拉·盖尔来到索格伦之前，她就已经存在于这片大地上了。她的目的对我们都是一个谜。不过见到她要保持恭敬的态度，这样她就可能会为你提供建议。”——艾蕊达，写给多南
raw_zh.name: 巫婆巨杖

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Petrified{/c} enemies have a {c_random}[80 - 100]%[+]{/c} increased chance to be Critically Struck and take {c_random}[60 - 90]%[x]{/c} increased damage. Additionally, {c_important}Earth{/c} Skills {c_important}Petrify{/c} {c_important}{u}Healthy{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}3{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Well did she feed her children, and well did her children feed her." -Scosglen folktale
raw_en.name: The Basilisk

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}被石化{/c}的敌人被暴击的几率提高 {c_random}[80 - 100]%[+]{/c}，受到的伤害提高 {c_random}[60 - 90]%[x]{/c}。此外，{c_important}大地{/c}技能会{c_important}石化{/c}{c_important}{u}健康{/u}{/c}的敌人，持续 {c_number}3{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “她喂饱了她的孩子，她的孩子也喂饱了她。”——索格伦传说
raw_zh.name: 蛇怪之杖

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Fireball{/c} deals {c_random}[140 - 180]%[x]{/c} increased damage and every {c_number}3rd{/c} Cast launches {c_number}2{/c} additional projectiles.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Leaving even blackened bones for your kin to mourn is too good an end for you." 
- Josiah
raw_en.name: Staff of Endless Rage

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}火球{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[140 - 180]%[x]{/c}，并且每第 {c_number}3{/c} 次施放会额外发射 {c_number}2{/c} 枚投射物。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: "给你的亲人们留下一堆发黑的骨头供他们哀悼算是便宜你了。" - 约西亚
raw_zh.name: 无尽怒火法杖

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Charged Bolts{/c} deal {c_random}[110 - 160]%[x]{/c} increased damage, last {c_number}300%{/c} longer and seek enemies.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Also known as the Greatstaff of the Old Religion, this powerful relic is one of only a small handful of Skatsimi artifacts that have survived to this day."
- Barrett's Book of Implements
raw_en.name: Staff of Lam Esen

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}电荷弹{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[110 - 160]%[x]{/c}，持续时间延长 {c_number}300%{/c}，并且会追踪敌人。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这件强大的古物也被称为旧教巨杖，它是迄今为止幸存下来的少数斯卡辛密教圣器之一。” - 巴雷特的《名器谱》
raw_zh.name: 兰姆·艾森之杖

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Unstable Currents{/c} increases your Armor and Resistances by {c_number}100%[+]{/c} and kills increase your damage by {c_random}2,000.0%[x]{/c} for the duration.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "To walk the Path of Zerae, do not seek to control the storm within. Lose yourself to it, let it leave your body and become your shroud. Then you will see yourself as its master." -Queen Xaera
raw_en.name: Staff of Zerae

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}不稳电流{/c}使你的护甲和抗性提高 {c_number}100%[+]{/c}，且在持续期间内的击杀会使你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}2,000.0%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “要踏上泽瑞伊之道，不要试图控制内心的风暴。要让自己沉浸其中，让它离开你的身体，成为你的裹尸布。然后，你就会发现自己成为了它的主人。”——赛伊拉女王
raw_zh.name: 泽瑞伊之杖

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal [2,200 - 5,400] Poisoning Damage over 10 seconds
implict: +15.0% Chance for an extra item from the Purveyor of Curiosities
raw_en.name: Edge

affixesDesc: 幸运一击: 最多有 40% 几率在 10 秒内造成 [2,200 - 5,400] 点中毒伤害
implict: +15.0% 几率从珍品商处额外获得一件物品
raw_zh.name: 锐锋

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Casting a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill triggers a random equipped {c_important}Basic{/c} Skill at a random enemy which deals {c_random}[300 - 360]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Your incantations are echoed by a chorus of the damned. Wield their torment, their vengeance, their pain against the Hellborne that tortured them.
raw_en.name: Vox Omnium

affixesDesc: {c_unique}施放{c_important}核心{/c}技能时会向一名随机敌人触发一个随机装备的{c_important}基础{/c}技能，造成 {c_random}[300 - 360]%[x]{/c} 额外伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 和你口中咒语交相呼应的，只有天谴者的哀嚎。用他们受到的折磨、苦痛和心中复仇的怒火来对抗蹂躏他们的魔裔吧。
raw_zh.name: 纷乱之声

raw_zh.name: 无限

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}40%{/c} chance to deal {c_number}1,500{/c} Shadow damage to surrounding enemies and reduce their damage dealt by {c_number}25%{/c} for {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Paladin, Warlock
raw_en.flavor: Whenever this ancient sword has reappeared throughout history, it portends a time of great strife, as well as a devastating loss of life.
raw_en.name: Doombringer

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}{c_label}幸运一击: {/c} 最多有 {c_number}40%{/c} 几率对周围敌人造成 {c_number}1,500{/c} 点暗影伤害，并使其造成的伤害降低 {c_number}25%{/c}，持续 {c_number}5{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 每当这把古剑重现于世，都预示着一个充满纷争的时代，以及无数生命的毁灭。
raw_zh.name: 末日使者

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}Your attacks condemn enemies. When they become {u}{c_important}Injured{/c}{/u}, they are smote for {c_number}37,500{/c} Holy damage for each time they were condemned, up to {c_number}100{/c} times.{/c}
raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Paladin, Warlock
raw_en.flavor: You hold Justice itself in your hands.
raw_en.name: El'Druin, Sword of Justice

affixesDesc: {c_mythic}你的攻击会对敌人施加定罪。当敌人进入{u}{c_important}受伤{/c}{/u}状态时，每受到一次定罪，便会遭到重击并受到 {c_number}37,500{/c} 点神圣伤害，最多计算 {c_number}100{/c} 次。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 你将正义本身握在手中。
raw_zh.name: 艾尔度因，正义之剑

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Skills deal {c_random}[0.35 - 0.50]%[x]{/c} increased damage per point of Fury you have, but {c_number}7%{/c} Fury Drains per second while in combat.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"Without him the wine is less sweet, the hearth less warm, and our blades less keen. Our blood brother is gone, but Bul-Kathos willing, we will meet again one day."
- Sorrowsong for Ramaladni
raw_en.name: Ramaladni's Magnum Opus

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你每有 1 点怒气，技能造成的伤害便提高 {c_random}[0.35 - 0.50]%[x]{/c}，但在战斗期间每秒会损失 {c_number}7%{/c} 点怒气。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “没有了他，佳酿不再甘甜，壁炉不再温暖，刀刃也不再锋利。我们的血亲走了，但是只要布尔凯索愿意，他总有一天会和我们重聚。” - 拉玛兰迪的悲歌
raw_zh.name: 拉玛兰迪的杰作

affixesDesc: {c_unique}You gain {c_random}[3.0 - 4.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage for each damaging Skill you have equipped, and an additional {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]%[x]{/c} for {c_number}15{/c} seconds when each of those Skills are used.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: A foul blizzard trapped the clans after the Battle of Nine Winters. Then came a pale stallion born of the peaks, and the storm parted before him. Tsasgal, they named him - chief of all horses.
raw_en.name: Sabre of Tsasgal

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每有一个装备的伤害技能，使你造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[3.0 - 4.0]%[x]{/c}，并且在使用每一个技能时，额外提高 {c_random}[6.0 - 8.0]%[x]{/c}，持续 {c_number}15{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 九冬之战过后，一场恶劣的暴雪令部族举步维艰。一匹苍白的公马自群峰中现身，风暴顿时消散无踪。他们称其为萨斯加尔，万马之首。
raw_zh.name: 萨斯加尔的马刀

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your {c_important}Weapon Mastery{/c} Skills are now also {c_important}Core{/c} Skills that have {c_number}100%{/c} Cooldown Reduction but cost Fury, dealing {c_random}[140 - 160]%{/c} of normal damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Restraint, mercy, honor...these are shackles, forged by the weak and the conquered." -Hephasto, the Armorer
raw_en.name: The Third Blade

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的{c_important}武器精通{/c}技能同时算作{c_important}核心{/c}技能，拥有 {c_number}100%{/c} 冷却时间缩减，但是会消耗怒气，造成正常伤害的 {c_random}[140 - 160]%{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “克制、仁慈、荣耀……这些美德其实都是镣铐，而铸就它们的则是弱者与被征服者的枯骨。”——防具师赫法斯托
raw_zh.name: 三重美德之锋

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Brandish{/c} unleashes in all directions dealing {c_random}[120 - 160]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The scroll's words are known to the knight alone. He supplicates to his sworn oath, lest his faith and blade find no purchase.
raw_en.name: Supplication

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}挥舞打击{/c}会向所有方向释放，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[120 - 160]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 卷轴上的文字只有骑士知晓。他祈求自己所立的誓言，以免他的信仰与刀刃无处安放。
raw_zh.name: 祈愿

raw_en.flavor: Griswold created wonders at his anvil. But, none ever stilled his hands - for every new blade bore dissatisfaction. Though his final work was left unfinished, it was hailed as his greatest.
raw_en.name: Griswold's Opus

raw_zh.flavor: 格里斯沃尔德在他的铁砧上创造了奇迹。但是，没有什么能让他的双手停下——因为每一把新刀刃都带着缺憾。尽管他的最后一件作品未完成，但它被誉为他最伟大的杰作。
raw_zh.name: 格里斯沃尔德的杰作

raw_en.flavor: A trapped prey only awaits a swift death. Sisters of the Sightless Eye will grant them this mercy.
raw_en.name: Misericorde

raw_zh.flavor: 被困的猎物只能等待速死。盲眼姐妹会将赐予他们这种慈悲。
raw_zh.name: 慈悲短剑

affixesDesc: {c_unique}After {c_important}{u}Freeze{/u}{/c} expires, enemies take {c_random}[120 - 150]%{/c} of the damage you dealt to them while {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c}.{/c}
raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Paladin, Warlock
raw_en.flavor: The ancient runeblade of the angel Izual, Azurewrath was miraculously spared the corruption that consumed its master.
raw_en.name: Azurewrath

affixesDesc: {c_unique}敌人的{c_important}{u}冻结{/u}{/c}效果结束后，会受到相当于其{c_important}{u}冻结{/u}{/c}期间你对其造成伤害 {c_random}[120 - 150]%{/c} 的伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 作为天使衣卒尔的古老符文剑，碧蓝怒火奇迹般地没有遭受吞噬其主人的腐化力量的影响。
raw_zh.name: 碧蓝怒火

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Defeating an Elite pack reduces your Skill Cooldowns by {c_random}[8 - 10]{/c} seconds for {c_number}15{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Paladin, Warlock
raw_en.flavor: "Ahh, the In-Geom! The royal smiths of Xiansai folded the spirits of not one—but four tigers into the steel! Come! Put your ear to its edge. You can almost hear them... Meow!" -Covetous Shen
raw_en.name: In-Geom

affixesDesc: {c_unique}击败一群精英怪物会使你的技能冷却时间缩短 {c_random}[8 - 10]{/c} 秒，持续 {c_number}15{/c} 秒。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: “啊，寅剑！仙塞的御用铁匠把四只猛虎的灵魂一并锻进了钢里，可不是一只哦！来，把耳朵贴到刃口上。你几乎能听见它们……喵！”——沈老贪
raw_zh.name: 寅剑

affixesDesc:

raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Paladin, Warlock
raw_en.flavor: This blade once bore divine purpose wielded by the angel Verathiel. Like its keeper, the sword fell to Infernal depths. Yet beneath this corruption, is a heartbeat of a past memory, holding steadfast.
raw_en.name: Shard of Verathiel

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}基础{/c}技能造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[70 - 100]%[x]{/c}, 但额外消耗 {c_number}25{/c} 点主要资源。{/c}
raw_zh.charName: 巫师, 德鲁伊, 野蛮人, 游侠, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 这把剑曾是天使维拉瑟尔的佩剑，一度承载了神圣的使命。但后来，它和它的主人都堕入了地狱的深处。然而在腐化之下，过往的记忆依旧在剑身中回响，从未消退半分。
raw_zh.name: 维拉瑟尔的碎片

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} is now an {c_important}Archfiend{/c} Skill and deals {c_random}[30 - 50]%[x]{/c} increased damage. {c_important}Blazing Scream{/c} gains the Skull Splitter Variant for free and the Lesser Demon skulls deal the same damage as the main skull. {/c}
raw_en.flavor: Weave a song from the damned. Pluck their sorrows like harp strings, for there is fuel in the tears of the profane.
raw_en.name: Elegy

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}炽焰尖啸{/c}现在属于{c_important}高等恶魔{/c}技能，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 50]%[x]{/c}。{c_important}炽焰尖啸{/c}免费获得凿颅者变种，且低阶恶魔头骨造成的伤害与主头骨相同。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 为亡者编织一曲挽歌。像拨动琴弦般拨弄他们的哀愁，因为亵渎者的泪水即是力量之源。
raw_zh.name: 挽歌

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Hitting a Lesser Demon with {c_important}Bombardment{/c} explodes it for {c_random}[400 - 600]%[x]{/c} of a {c_important}Bombardment{/c} impact if the Demon has less than {c_number}3{/c} seconds duration left. {c_important}Bombardment{/c} deals {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The third lord of Hashir hungered to see all beneath his rule. A Warlock obliged and bound a demon into steel. The king bore the blade and beheld how his realm was cast down before him.
raw_en.name: The Blade of Sight Aflame

affixesDesc: {c_unique}如果低阶恶魔的剩余持续时间少于 {c_number}3{/c} 秒，{c_important}恶鬼轰击{/c}命中它时会使其爆炸，造成相当于一次{c_important}恶鬼轰击{/c}命中伤害 {c_random}[400 - 600]%[x]{/c} 的伤害。{c_important}恶鬼轰击{/c}造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 哈希尔的第三任领主渴望统御万物。一名术士满足了他的心愿，将恶魔禁锢在钢铁之中。国王挥舞着那把利刃，却眼睁睁看着他的王国在面前崩塌。
raw_zh.name: 燃目流火之刃

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Your direct damage inflicts {c_random}40%{/c} bonus Poisoning damage over {c_number}5{/c} seconds.{/c}
raw_en.charName: Sorcerer, Druid, Barbarian, Rogue, Necromancer, Paladin, Warlock
raw_en.name: Grief

affixesDesc: {c_unique}你的直接伤害会在 {c_number}5{/c} 秒内额外造成 {c_random}40%{/c} 点毒素伤害。{/c}

raw_en.flavor: An unbroken lineage of unwavering strength.
raw_en.name: The Grandfather

raw_zh.charName: 野蛮人, 死灵法师, 圣骑士, 术士
raw_zh.flavor: 力量不动如山，传承延绵万代。
raw_zh.name: 祖父

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Rupture's{/c} rip deals {c_random}[75 - 100]%{/c} of the total Bleeding damage on an enemy instantly, removing all Bleeding damage from them.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "We've been fighting these flesh-eaters for so long, been soaked in so much blood, that after a while it's difficult to tell what side you're truly on." -Daelyr, Crane Tribe warrior
raw_en.name: Fields of Crimson

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}割裂{/c}的拔出效果会立即造成敌人身上总流血伤害的 {c_random}[75 - 100]%{/c}，并移除他们身上所有的流血伤害。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “我们已经与这些肉食者战斗了很长时间，现在身上都是鲜血，再过一段时间就很难分辨出你究竟是哪一边的人了。” ——迪力尔，鹤族战士
raw_zh.name: 修罗场

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}Your {c_important}Summons'{/c} damage afflict enemies with {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}. Consuming a Corpse also contributes {c_number}3{/c} souls to {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}, which can now stack up to {c_number}20{/c} souls.

Only {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} can now unleash the souls from {c_important}{u}Vampiric Curse{/u}{/c}, causing both {c_important}Army of the Dead{/c} and the souls to deal {c_random}[40.0 - 50.0]%[x]{/c} increased damage per soul unleashed.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The parched blade keens, longing to serve its master.
raw_en.name: Sanguivor, Blade of Zir

affixesDesc:
{c_unique}你的{c_important}召唤物{/c}在造成伤害时，还会对敌人施加{c_important}{u}吸血鬼诅咒{/u}{/c}。此外，消耗一具亡骸会向{c_important}{u}吸血鬼诅咒{/u}{/c}中存入 {c_number}3{/c} 个灵魂，最多可以储存 {c_number}20{/c} 个灵魂。

现在只有{c_important}亡者大军{/c}可以释放出{c_important}{u}吸血鬼诅咒{/u}{/c}中储存的灵魂。每释放出一个灵魂，{c_important}亡者大军{/c}和灵魂造成的伤害都会提高 {c_random}[40.0 - 50.0]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 渴血的锋刃连声哀鸣，希望为它的主人效力。
raw_zh.name: 殷红飨宴，齐尔的巨刃

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Zeal{/c} gains the {c_important}Death or Glory{/c} Variant for free and deals {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c} increased damage.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: "Thus spake Que-Hegan Sankekur the righteous: when prayer fails man, let the blade be our psalm. May the blood of unbelievers be the ink which we write our faith anew." -Excerpt from Brother Ismail
raw_en.name: Red Sermon

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}狂热{/c}免费获得{c_important}死亡与荣耀{/c}变体，并且造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[100 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “正义的魁黑刚圣柯库如是说：当祈祷对人无效时，让刀刃成为我们的圣歌。愿不信者的鲜血成为我们重写信仰的墨水。”——摘自伊斯梅尔修士语录
raw_zh.name: 血色布道

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Hitting enemies with a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill increases the damage they take from you by {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c} per Skill, up to {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c}. {c_important}Archfiend{/c} {c_important}{u}Demonform{/u}{/c} Skill Variants are {c_important}Core{/c} Skills and cost Wrath.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: Hatred begins the first cut. Terror holds the wound. Destruction comes at last, patient and certain, to devour what remains.
raw_en.name: Anathema of the Primes

affixesDesc: {c_unique}每用一个{c_important}核心{/c}技能击中敌人就会使其受到来自你的伤害提高 {c_random}[30 - 40]%[x]{/c}，最多提高 {c_random}[90 - 120]%[x]{/c}。{c_important}高等恶魔{/c}的{c_important}{u}恶魔形态{/u}{/c}技能变种属于{c_important}核心{/c}技能，并且消耗愤怒值。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 憎恨开启了第一道伤口，恐惧紧随其后。而毁灭，耐心且必然，最终将残余的一切吞噬。
raw_zh.name: 魔神绝罚

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}Incinerate{/c} gains one final charge, irradiating the area around you and increasing damage dealt by {c_random}[200 - 300]%[x]{/c} but costing an additional {c_number}50{/c} Mana per second.{/c}
raw_en.flavor: The burn may heal, but the pain is eternal.
raw_en.name: Flamescar

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}焚烧{/c}获得最后一次充能，可辐射你周围的区域，造成的伤害提高 {c_random}[200 - 300]%[x]{/c}，但每秒额外消耗 {c_number}50{/c} 点法力。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: 灼伤也许能够治愈，但痛感永远不会消失。
raw_zh.name: 焰痕

affixesDesc: {c_unique}Each enemy hit by {c_important}Teleport{/c} increases the damage by {c_random}[10.0 - 15.0]%[x]{/c} and reduces the Cooldown by {c_number}0.50{/c} of the next Cast. Becoming {c_important}Injured{/c} will {c_important}Teleport{/c} you to a random location.{/c}
raw_en.flavor:
"The rhythm of the orb, which had pulsed steadily for five centuries, quickened as its owner took his final ragged breaths. It were as if some intelligence within reveled in the sight."
- Master Eos
raw_en.name: The Oculus

affixesDesc: {c_unique}{c_important}传送术{/c}每击中一名敌人，都会使你下一次施放的伤害提高 {c_random}[10.0 - 15.0]%[x]{/c} 且冷却时间缩短 {c_number}0.50{/c}。进入{c_important}受伤{/c}状态会使你{c_important}传送{/c}到随机位置。{/c}
raw_zh.flavor: “这颗宝珠的韵律已经稳定跳动了五个世纪，在其主人急促地咽下最后一口气时，节奏加快了。仿佛里面有某种智慧陶醉于眼前的一幕。” - 伊奥斯大师
raw_zh.name: 法瞳

affixesDesc: Lucky Hit: Up to a 40% Chance to Deal +[1,500 - 2,400] Fire Damage
